interfaces.name: MoodID
interfaces.signature: enum MoodID: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Hashable { case radiant, calm, wistful, restless, tender, fierce, hazy, hopeful }
interfaces.notes: Fixed 8-value vocabulary, radial wheel ordering used for palette hue mapping.

interfaces.name: ChipID
interfaces.signature: struct ChipID: RawRepresentable, Codable, Hashable { let rawValue: String } // 24 curated values across 4 families (texture/weather/pace/company), 6 each
interfaces.notes: User selects 1-2 per check-in; family grouping only affects curation, not selection logic.

interfaces.name: TimeOfDayBucket
interfaces.signature: enum TimeOfDayBucket: String, Codable { case dawn, day, dusk, night }
interfaces.notes: Resolved and frozen once at generation time per DEC-product_research-003; never recomputed.

interfaces.name: EntitlementSnapshot
interfaces.signature: struct EntitlementSnapshot: Codable, Hashable { let isAuraPlus: Bool; let unlockedPaletteTier: PaletteTier; let capturedAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: Snapshotted onto each DayEntry at generation; never recomputed live per DEC-detailed_discussion-011.

interfaces.name: AuraRecipe
interfaces.signature: struct AuraRecipe: Codable, Hashable { let dateKey: String; let mood: MoodID; let chips: [ChipID]; let timeOfDay: TimeOfDayBucket; let entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot; let regenerationNonce: Int; let compositionFamily: CompositionFamily; let paletteIndex: Int; let flowFieldSeed: UInt64; let warpAngleBias: Double; let densityValue: Double; let colorGradeCurveID: Int; let captionFragmentIndices: [CaptionSlot: Int] }
interfaces.notes: The pure GPU-free determinism contract per DEC-ios_architecture_review-002; nonce>0 recipes are produced via RegenerationDivergenceEngine, not a fresh independent draw.

interfaces.name: SeedEngine.generateRecipe
interfaces.signature: static func generateRecipe(dateKey: String, mood: MoodID, chips: [ChipID], timeOfDay: TimeOfDayBucket, entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot, regenerationNonce: Int, captionHistory: CaptionEligibilityQuery) -> AuraRecipe
interfaces.notes: For nonce==0, pure hash-derived draw. For nonce>0, computes the nonce==0 base recipe then applies RegenerationDivergenceEngine.perturb.

interfaces.name: CaptionEligibilityQuery
interfaces.signature: protocol CaptionEligibilityQuery { func recentlyUsedFragmentIndices(mood: MoodID, slot: CaptionSlot, withinDays: Int) -> Set<Int> }
interfaces.notes: Backed by a SwiftData query over DayEntry in the app; a fake/in-memory conformer used in AuraKit unit tests.

interfaces.name: DayEntry
interfaces.signature: @Model final class DayEntry { @Attribute(.unique) var dateKey: String; var mood: MoodID; var chips: [ChipID]; var recipe: AuraRecipe; var fullResImagePath: String; var thumbnailImagePath: String; var bloomIntermediatePaths: [String]; var captionText: String; var isDemo: Bool; var regenerationNonce: Int; var timeZoneIdentifierAtCompletion: String; var createdAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: Canonical identity is dateKey, never array index/UUID; regeneration replaces this record's fields in place per DEC-initial_discussion-006.

interfaces.name: MonthlyWrapped
interfaces.signature: @Model final class MonthlyWrapped { @Attribute(.unique) var monthKey: String; var posterImagePath: String; var dominantPaletteIndex: Int; var moodDistribution: [MoodID: Int]; var isPartial: Bool; var generatedAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: isPartial distinguishes the on-demand mini-recap from a real month-end Wrapped.

interfaces.name: SchemaV1 / AuraMigrationPlan
interfaces.signature: enum SchemaV1: VersionedSchema { static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] { [DayEntry.self, MonthlyWrapped.self] } }; enum AuraMigrationPlan: SchemaMigrationPlan { static var schemas: [any VersionedSchema.Type] { [SchemaV1.self] }; static var stages: [MigrationStage] { [] } }
interfaces.notes: Per DEC-ios_architecture_review-003; empty stage list at v1, extend when v2 lands.

interfaces.name: ModelContainerFactory.makeContainer
interfaces.signature: static func makeContainer(inMemory: Bool = false) throws -> ModelContainer // must configure cloudKitDatabase: .none
interfaces.notes: Build-time audit point for DEC-per_app_product_brief-005; store lives in default app container, NOT the App Group.

interfaces.name: AuraClock
interfaces.signature: protocol AuraClock { func now() -> Date; func currentTimeZone() -> TimeZone }
interfaces.notes: SystemClock (live) and TestClock (XCTest, settable now/timezone) both conform; injected into AuraStore and DayStateResolver.

interfaces.name: DayStateResolver
interfaces.signature: struct DayStateResolver { let clock: AuraClock; func canonicalDayKey() -> String; func isLocked(against entries: [DayEntry]) -> Bool; func canRegenerate(against entries: [DayEntry], entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: Single source of truth for both daily lock and regeneration credit per DEC-detailed_discussion-002; derives from persisted DayEntry query per DEC-ios_architecture_review-004, never a cached scalar.

interfaces.name: AuraRenderer
interfaces.signature: protocol AuraRenderer { func renderBloomIntermediates(recipe: AuraRecipe) async -> [CIImage]; func renderThumbnail(recipe: AuraRecipe) async -> CGImage; func renderFullExport(recipe: AuraRecipe, watermarked: Bool) async -> CGImage; func renderWrappedPoster(month: MonthlyWrapped, entries: [DayEntry]) async -> CGImage }
interfaces.notes: Single CIContext-backed implementation per DEC-ios_architecture_review-001, with 3 internal composition-family branches (paintBloom/particleField/flowLines) sharing the same context/filter infrastructure. renderBloomIntermediates MUST return exactly 4 CIImages for every family per DEC-tech_specs-014 — family differences live inside each of the 4 stages, never by changing stage count.

interfaces.name: AuraStore
interfaces.signature: @MainActor @Observable final class AuraStore { var pendingDeepLink: PendingDeepLink?; var demoModeEnabled: Bool; private(set) var entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot; func canonicalDayKey() -> String; func todayEntry() -> DayEntry? }
interfaces.notes: Sole owner of day-state/entitlement/demo-mode per DEC-design_handoff-001; wraps DayStateResolver, never queried around.

interfaces.name: PendingDeepLink / TodayRoute / ArchiveRoute / WrappedRoute
interfaces.signature: enum PendingDeepLink { case today(TodayRoute); case archive(ArchiveRoute); case wrapped(WrappedRoute) }; enum TodayRoute { case checkIn; case revealed }; enum ArchiveRoute { case detail(dateKey: String) }; enum WrappedRoute { case poster(monthKey: String) }
interfaces.notes: Consumed once via .onChange per DEC-design_handoff-002 for widget-tap navigation.

interfaces.name: StoreKitManager
interfaces.signature: actor StoreKitManager { func purchaseAuraPlus() async throws -> EntitlementSnapshot; func restorePurchases() async throws -> EntitlementSnapshot?; func startEntitlementListener(onChange: @escaping @Sendable (EntitlementSnapshot) -> Void) }
interfaces.notes: Backed by live Transaction.updates listener per DEC-detailed_discussion-006; restorePurchases returns nil for honest 'nothing to restore'.

interfaces.name: WidgetReloadCoordinator.reload
interfaces.signature: static func reload() // calls WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()
interfaces.notes: Called at two distinct sites: check-in completion and successful regeneration, per DEC-detailed_discussion-013.

interfaces.name: NotificationScheduler
interfaces.signature: struct NotificationScheduler { func scheduleReminderIfNeeded(dayState: DayStateResolver) async; func cancelPendingReminder() async; func requestPermissionIfNeeded() async -> UNAuthorizationStatus }
interfaces.notes: Cancellation is part of the check-in completion transaction per DEC-detailed_discussion-004.

interfaces.name: ExportPipeline.makeShareableImage
interfaces.signature: func makeShareableImage(entry: DayEntry, watermarked: Bool) -> Transferable & Sendable // 1080x1920, EXIF-stripped, bundled watermark asset
interfaces.notes: Feeds SwiftUI ShareLink(item:) per DEC-ios_architecture_review-006; watermark composited by AuraRenderer, never a live UI screenshot.

interfaces.name: CachedCardMetadata
interfaces.signature: struct CachedCardMetadata: Codable { let dateKey: String; let hasCheckedInToday: Bool; let thumbnailFileName: String?; let dominantPaletteHex: String? }
interfaces.notes: Written to the App Group shared container by the app after generation/regeneration; the only thing AuraWidget ever reads.

interfaces.name: AccessibilityDescriptionBuilder.describe
interfaces.signature: static func describe(entry: DayEntry) -> String // e.g. "a warm, calm morning aura"
interfaces.notes: Metadata-based per DEC-detailed_discussion-008, never pixel/visual description.

interfaces.name: PaletteTier
interfaces.signature: enum PaletteTier: String, Codable { case freeBase, auraPlusExpanded }
interfaces.notes: freeBase draws paletteIndex mod 16; auraPlusExpanded draws mod 32 (full library).

interfaces.name: DemoHistoryAnchor.dateRange
interfaces.signature: static func dateRange(installDate: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> ClosedRange<Date> // fixed range strictly before installDate
interfaces.notes: OPEN: stub signature only; concrete anchoring rule per DEC-detailed_discussion-005 still needs to be written out next round.

interfaces.name: MoodTrendAggregator.distribution
interfaces.signature: static func distribution(entries: [DayEntry], range: DateInterval) -> [MoodID: Int]
interfaces.notes: OPEN: stub only. Feeds the Swift Charts mood-distribution trend view nested in Archive (DEC-initial_discussion-002); real chart-data-point interface still needed next round.

interfaces.name: CompositionFamily
interfaces.signature: enum CompositionFamily: String, Codable, CaseIterable { case paintBloom, particleField, flowLines }
interfaces.notes: Maps directly to the 3 visual languages named in the original prompt; drawn from its own hash lane for the base recipe, forced to a different family on regeneration.

interfaces.name: PaletteLibrary.paletteCount / resolvePalette
interfaces.signature: static func paletteCount(for tier: PaletteTier) -> Int; static func resolvePalette(index: Int, tier: PaletteTier) -> Palette
interfaces.notes: 32 total curated palettes; free tier sees the first 16, Aura+ sees all 32.

interfaces.name: RegenerationDivergenceEngine.perturb
interfaces.signature: static func perturb(base: AuraRecipe, nonce: Int, paletteTier: PaletteTier) -> AuraRecipe
interfaces.notes: Structurally forces compositionFamily, paletteIndex, and flowFieldSeed to differ from base via nonzero modular offset / nonzero XOR mask (never probabilistic); satisfies DEC-per_app_product_brief-002's >=2-of-3 bar by algebraic construction, verifiable in a single deterministic unit test across many seeds.

interfaces.name: DemoHistoryAnchor.resolveAndPersist
interfaces.signature: static func resolveAndPersist(existingRealEntries: [DayEntry], today: Date, calendar: Calendar, store: DemoAnchorStore) -> ClosedRange<Date>
interfaces.notes: Computed exactly once on first demo-mode enable (34-day range ending 1 day before earliest real entry or today), then persisted via DemoAnchorStore so later toggles never recompute or drift; per DEC-detailed_discussion-005.

interfaces.name: DemoAnchorStore
interfaces.signature: protocol DemoAnchorStore { func loadPersistedAnchor() -> ClosedRange<Date>?; func persist(_ range: ClosedRange<Date>) }
interfaces.notes: UserDefaults-backed in the app target; in-memory fake in AuraKit tests.

interfaces.name: TrendGranularity
interfaces.signature: enum TrendGranularity: String, CaseIterable { case daily, weekly, monthly }
interfaces.notes: Archive's segmented trend control per DEC-initial_discussion-002; weekly is the default for a ~30 day window.

interfaces.name: MoodTrendDataPoint
interfaces.signature: struct MoodTrendDataPoint: Identifiable, Hashable { var id: String { "\(bucketDate)-\(mood.rawValue)" }; let bucketDate: Date; let mood: MoodID; let count: Int }
interfaces.notes: Feeds Swift Charts directly, e.g. BarMark(x: .value("Week", bucketDate), y: .value("Count", count)).foregroundStyle(by: .value("Mood", mood)).

interfaces.name: MoodTrendAggregator.chartData
interfaces.signature: static func chartData(entries: [DayEntry], range: DateInterval, granularity: TrendGranularity) -> [MoodTrendDataPoint]
interfaces.notes: Includes isDemo entries identically to real ones (demo-vs-real distinction is handled visually at the archive/banner level, not by excluding data from the aggregate).

interfaces.name: Palette
interfaces.signature: struct Palette: Codable, Hashable, Identifiable { let id: Int; let primaryHex: String; let secondaryHex: String; let accentHex: String; let backgroundWashHex: String }
interfaces.notes: One of 32 curated entries resolved by PaletteLibrary; consumed by AuraRenderer's color-grade stage.

interfaces.name: CaptionSlot
interfaces.signature: enum CaptionSlot: String, Codable, CaseIterable { case opener, moodCore, closer }
interfaces.notes: The 3 independently-tracked fragment slots per DEC-tech_specs-004; each has its own 30-day no-repeat window via CaptionEligibilityQuery.
